  • One shot donations via bitcoin. PayPal being largely blocked.

  • Gold feature.
  • Memorabilia / Merchandise sales
  • Opt-in Advertisements (don't pop an artery just yet, I'll explain)

So the opt-in ads work like this: I'm a poor student and I have no money to donate to Voat, so I go into my settings and check "[x] Show me ads so I can help Voat" A little counter appears under the ad to show me how much money I've earned for Voat. I make up my mind to watch 5$ worth of ads each month, just enough for a gold. This I give to a submission I find particularly worthy and Voat gets money.

The best part is that nobody except me has to see any ads. I watch them because I choose and I can give up any time.

So what could be done with this money?

  • More servers
  • More developers
  • Money to hire lawyers

I imagine these are the most immediate needs. With more money there are even cooler things that can be done:

  • With enough money and devs Voat can become its own CDN ending its dependency to other providers.
  • Donating money to Open Source projects and charities. (You must remember the campaign on the other site which ended up donating good sums to EFF and FSF among others) It was the last great thing they did before going downhill.
  • Supporting a marketplace for devs artists etc.
  • Own coin exchange
